articles.summary: Developers invited to explore emotion, voice and movement using the Arduino UNO R4 WiFi powered by the Renesas RA4M1 microcontroller PHOENIX – Hackster, an Avnet community, has launched Emotion in Motion, a robotics design challenge inviting developers, engineers, makers and students to create projects exploring emotion, voice and motor control. Hackster is giving away 500 Arduino® UNO R4 WiFi boards, powered by the Renesas RA4M1 microcontroller, to help participants bring their ideas to life. Emotion in Motion challenges participants to explore the more human side of robotics and electronics. articles.title: Hackster launches Emotion in Motion robotics design challenge with Renesas and Arduino
